product_overview: Klolakelas is a modern Learning Management System focused on teacher productivity and student engagement, providing secure authentication and role-specific dashboards for teachers (Guru) and students (Siswa). It centralizes class management, attendance and grade tracking, and student-facing progress views.
core_goals: Provide secure role-based access for teachers and students to their respective dashboards.
Enable teachers to manage classes, record attendance, and maintain a unified gradebook efficiently.
Allow students to view enrolled classes, attendance status, and grades/feedback in real time.
Deliver a responsive, mobile-first experience with fast server-state synchronization via Supabase and TanStack Query.
Support immediate, actionable error messages and validation to reduce user friction during key flows (login, registration, grading).

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Secure login and registration flows for teachers and students with clear validation and role-aware routing.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter email and password -> Submit login form -> See role-specific dashboard (/guru or /siswa)
Navigate to /login -> Enter invalid credentials -> Submit login form -> View error message for invalid credentials
Navigate to /register -> Enter registration details and select role -> Submit registration form -> Complete onboarding and land on role-specific dashboard
Navigate to /register -> Enter an email already in use or incomplete details -> Submit registration form -> View error message about duplicate account or missing fields

features.name: Guru (Teacher) Dashboard
features.description: Role-specific dashboard for teachers to view class overview, manage students and classes, record attendance, and maintain grades.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter email and password -> Submit login form -> Navigate to /guru -> View dashboard overview -> Manage classes and students -> Track attendance and record grades -> See updated class roster and gradebook
Navigate to /guru without authentication -> See authentication required and be redirected to /login
Navigate to /login -> Enter email and password -> Submit login form -> Navigate to /guru -> Track attendance and record grades with invalid input -> View validation error message

features.name: Siswa (Student) Dashboard
features.description: Student-facing dashboard to access enrolled classes, check attendance status, and view grades and task feedback.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter email and password -> Submit login form -> Navigate to /siswa -> View enrolled classes -> Check attendance status -> View grades and task feedback
Navigate to /siswa without authentication -> See authentication required and be redirected to /login

Navigate to /login -> Enter email and password for a student account with missing enrollment -> Submit login form -> Navigate to /siswa -> View empty enrolled classes state and see guidance to join a class
